[0] Apple has extended the testing period for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, and is now rolling out the seventh release candidate (RC) for both systems. Here are the details.

[1] [1] A new round of release candidates arrives

[2] [2] Apple released the sixth release candidate of macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 just four days ago, while also rolling out the first release candidate of macOS 26.6.

[3] [3] Based on the timing and the number of release candidates, it would be natural to assume these are the final rounds of testing before official release. That is not the case.

[4] [4] Apple today released the seventh release candidate of macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, with the following build numbers:

  • [5] [5] macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • [6] [6] macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

[7] [7] The release candidates for both systems are now available for download by developers and public beta users.

[8] [8] Apple has yet to reveal the specific update contents for either system, only noting as usual that "this update provides important security fixes and is recommended for all users." Apple will very likely publish more details on the Apple security updates page after both systems are officially released.

[9] [9] Apple continues to release updates for older versions of its systems, bringing important bug fixes to users who are unable to upgrade to the latest software. This update is also likely similar in nature, so users still on macOS Sonoma or Sequoia should install it as soon as possible after it is publicly released (most likely early next week).
